snippet.title: Bloomkeeper - Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🌱  Welcome to Bloomkeeper: a cozy, poetic, and cooperative indie game where you play as a tiny forest Guardian, trying to bring nature back to life in an arid and mysterious world.

With the help of the Pouics, adorable, chaotic little creatures, explore magical biomes, grow life, and uncover the surprises that hide beneath the surface… 👀 
Each step you take lets nature breathe again.
Each Pouic thrown carries a little bit of magic.
And each corner of the world hides surprises waiting to bloom… or not 👀

Nature has never been so chaotic before ! 

🎮 Demo coming end of summer 2025
👥 Up to 4 players co-op
📍 Made with love in Montpellier, France by a small indie team

💚 Wishlist now to support the project and get notified when the demo drops!
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3034650/Bloomkeeper/?beta=0
